name: reporting_granularity_gap
description: 论文没有 seed、硬件/训练时长/FLOPs、task-level uncertainty、human/deployment evaluation 或细组件消融。

name: Early-stopping scope
description: The main diffusion guarantees first sample the early-stopped p1; reaching pdata requires a metric conversion and a σ0 choice.

name: Refined-condition scope
description: The refined analysis focuses on the variance-exploding setting and requires non-uniform operator/Frobenius controls, including Assumption 4.8 under p̃k.

name: Proximal-oracle exactness
description: Appendix G assumes zero error in the proximal point for simplicity; nonzero-error analysis is only referred to prior work.

name: Empirical validation
description: The work explicitly describes itself as primarily theoretical and leaves implementation and experimental evaluation for future work.

name: Concurrent-work comparison
description: Appendix A says the concurrent method uses Gaussian-convolution, sub-exponential score-error, and Lipschitz-score assumptions; the paper does not collapse the approaches to one uniformly measured setting.

name: Task scope
description: The stated representative scope is general reasoning in mathematics and coding.

name: RL model scope
description: JustGRPO post-training is applied to LLaDA-Instruct; three models are used for pre-RL Pass@k comparisons.

name: Causal identification
description: Connector entropy is measured during decoding, but no fork-level intervention or counterfactual context manipulation is reported.

name: Baseline comparability
description: Table 1 combines quoted results with heterogeneous decoding, update, fine-tuning, and data settings; Table 2 only aligns selected baselines.

name: Uncertainty reporting
description: No random-seed count, variance, uncertainty band, significance test, or interval is reported for the point estimates.

name: Compute and deployment
description: Exact likelihood requires per-position forward evaluations; efficiency evidence is a single GSM8K curve on 16×H100.

name: Bidirectional refinement
description: Iterative revision of already-decoded outputs is proposed as future work, not evaluated.
